newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end weaker, volume lowest for year.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end weaker, volume lowest for year.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed weaker on Monday, as participants hugged the sidelines due to an unclear outlook over Japan's financial reform plans and its economic recovery, brokers said. Trading was extremely thin, marking its smallest volume for the year.
The key Nikkei 225 average was down 133.36 points or 0.64 percent at 20,796.37. Its December futures lost 170 points to 20,800.
"The only thing we can say about the market is that we don't have anything to trade on," said Harushige Kobayashi, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
